label: EXPERIMENTAL / OOD
question: Can calibrating exact-score cells within fixed WDL and total-goals marginals improve J1 first and ordered-three score hits?
population: Use the exact R25 source-panel and R7-fit archives with their registered SHA-256 hashes, chronological anchor preparation and fixture-date windows. Fit on 2,291 regular-stage matches before 2025. Validate on the 218 regular-stage matches through June 2025. Evaluate separately on all 162 regular-stage matches from July through December 2025 and the 150 regular-stage matches in the original 2026/27 panel. These are date-separated development slices already used by other project studies. The original R26 forecast reference, SHA-256 d4d3fd092f6a006d0dfbc6f1df86a01df5c1dcb335f1e74d17221d70e1b98136, recorded 1-1 as the first in 99 of the latest 150 rows. This concentration motivates the hypothesis and supplies no unseen outcomes.
method: Multiply each strictly pre-date R7 training anchor score cell by exp(beta) for one of three disjoint categories: 1-1, a win with a clean sheet, and a one-goal win with both teams scoring. All other cells have multiplier one. Alternate proportional adjustment of total-goals rows and WDL columns to preserve each original marginal, with exact structural zeros and absolute marginal tolerance 2e-13. Fit on the resulting likelihood of the actual training score, plus 16 times the sum of squared coefficients. Coefficients are bounded by +/-0.65 with zero initialization. Apply the fixed tilt and projection to each archived R7 candidate matrix on validation and both evaluation windows. Preserve the signed WDL picks and actual-line totals decisions on all variants.
selection: Compare mixtures of the R7 distribution and the full projected distribution at doses 0, 0.5 and 1. In the validation set retain only doses with first and three hits both at least as high as R7. Choose by most first hits, then most three hits, then least exact-score log loss, then the smaller dose. Dose zero inherits the original published R7 choices exactly. Report the selected, half and full projections at the registered doses on both evaluation windows. Compare signed R7, historical market and every fixed dose on the same fixture identities, 90-minute results, and actual lines. Report paired gains, losses, date-clustered intervals, first and three-score counts, WDL, Asian settlement, coverage, and exact-score probability quality. Verify the largest total-goals and WDL marginal error.
forward: Use the two original December J1 competition windows frozen as 836802cb5ce13a38-v000001. If a positive selected dose gains in either combined score metric without losing in the other, reserve that dose for independent pregame research comparison with the same R7 prior. Freeze the recipe before the next slate and freeze any research predictions only using contemporaneous inputs, ahead of kickoff. Do not revise prior tracked displays or their ranked seats, award stage credit from history, or promote to a production model. If the screen is not met, the recipe stays as a completed development diagnostic and the original December first-display protocol proceeds.
